risks.title: Foreign currency fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first in the 10-K, with clear language on its impact on sales and profits. Although hedging is used, it does not guarantee full protection. The Macro category has a high weighting.

risks.title: Multiple legal proceedings
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates that several legal proceedings are ongoing, in preliminary stages, with uncertainty regarding potential loss amounts. The company believes, however, that the impact is not likely to be material.

risks.title: Significant contractual obligations
risks.score_rationale: The company has short- and long-term debt, lease obligations, pension commitments, and contracts with penalties. While not deemed concerning, they weigh on cash flow. Positioned centrally in the text.

risks.title: Seasonal product returns
risks.score_rationale: Returns of sun care products represent a major risk, with direct impact on sales and operating results. The risk is well documented in the context of product reformulations.

risks.title: Critical accounting estimates
risks.score_rationale: Estimates related to pensions, taxes, goodwill, and revenues have a direct impact on financial statements. The text emphasizes that deviations could be significant. Existential risk related to the reliability of financial reporting.

risks.title: Goodwill and intangible asset valuations
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill is subject to significant impairment charges in fiscal 2025. Future impairments could have a major impact on earnings. Technical language and high stakes.

risks.title: Environmental compliance
risks.score_rationale: Environmental costs are considered in operations, but the text notes uncertainty regarding future investments. Possible regulatory changes, particularly related to climate.

ai_positioning.summary: EPC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report. The information provided focuses on financial statements, business segments, and company operations without reference to AI.
